answer: An attacker as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 16 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The echo counter is kept in wharf and onyx shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 16 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4809 identities would post 1520 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
